_doc: Section classes (src/livereact/rekordbox/section_classes.py). The Track Classifier agent refines the rules; only Josh sets approved/scene. A rule of null names a class that is not defined yet. Nothing here changes the show until a class is approved.

classes.name: drop_snare_roll
classes.notes: Josh 2026-10-26: snare rolls are a class of drop (3-7 bars on his labels). Claude 2026-10-28: the planner now splits the last 8 bars of a long build (PLAN_ROLL_BEATS) off as the drop's roll lead-in (sections.py feature roll = 1); this class is exactly those sections. Since 58efe73 the roll is 4 bars when the waveform crescendos over the build's last 8 bars (PLAN_ROLL_RISE), else 8; the class covers both (library 2026-10-28: 136 sections in 108 tracks).

classes.name: drop_full
classes.notes: the groove/bass hit; at least 8 bars (Josh 2026-10-26)

classes.name: drop_clap
classes.notes: claps/crashes carry it, no real roll: soft strobe at most

classes.name: build_from_drop
classes.notes: Claude 2026-10-26: the drop falls away (the kick leaves) and the build starts from there. Library: builds between two drops have energy_delta p10/p50/p90 -0.39/-0.22/-0.06 (216 sections, 126 tracks); after a breakdown -0.07/+0.05/+0.19, after an intro -0.04/+0.08/+0.26. On the tuning tracks 6 of 10 such builds start on an ear breakdown or whiteout marker, 0 of 8 risers do: a power-off (STRUCT-05) then the ramp.

classes.name: build_riser
classes.notes: Claude 2026-10-26: a build out of a quiet section (intro, breakdown): already dark, so it only ramps.

classes.name: breakdown_kick_out
classes.notes: Claude 2026-10-26: a breakdown entered from a loud section (energy_delta p50 -0.27 after a drop, 121 sections). Every tuning-track planned breakdown is in it (-0.35..-0.52); the ear breakdowns there are power-offs (STRUCT-05) and 2-fixture static washes (TIME-06).

classes.name: outro_kick_out
classes.notes: Claude 2026-10-29: the kick leaves AT the outro boundary (energy falls >= 0.1 from the section before). 101 of the library's 209 outros. Same shape as breakdown_kick_out: a power-off step-down, then the quiet fade; OUTRO stays a version of BREAK (D4/D-22, never terminal).

classes.name: outro_still_hot
classes.notes: Claude 2026-10-29: rekordbox labels the final groove 'outro' but the music is still loud and did not fall (energy >= 0.4 and delta > -0.1, energy up to 0.71). 69 of 209 library outros. This is the shape behind Josh's open 'planned outro vs main groove to the end' question; quiet-edges dimming here fights the music. Example tracks and times in the night report (results/, 2026-10-29).

classes.name: intro_hot
classes.notes: Claude 2026-10-29: a DJ-tool intro that opens already banging (energy >= 0.35; the library's intro energy p90 is 0.33, so this is the top decile: 15 of 215 intros, energy up to 0.47). Quiet-edges makes these near-dark for 8 bars against a full beat. Example tracks in the night report (results/, 2026-10-29).
